Careers at Raz-Lee

Welcome to our International employment section. Here you can view our current job openings and apply for Careers at Raz-Lee online.

At Raz-Lee, we’re looking for employees who value openness, collaboration, determination, and individuality at work.

Raz-Lee Security's Interview Process

Here at Raz-Lee, we are always excited when people want to join our team. When we receive your application, you can be assured that our team will diligently review your profile, giving it the utmost consideration. Here’s what to expect if your profile is a good fit:

 

  1. You will be contacted directly by our recruitment team to get to know you better and allow you the chance to ask questions about our thriving company, corporate culture, and the position itself.
  2. If there is continued mutual interest in proceeding with the process, we’ll get phone interview scheduled so you can speak with the hiring manager.
  3. Finally, we will be excited to connect with you in person or via video call to meet and have a first hand impression about yourself as you are able to see how we operate at Raz-Lee.

 

While our interview process may vary from position to position, we are always cognizant and appreciative of your time and will strive for transparency and expediency in our process.

If you should have questions throughout the process, feel free to contact us at hr@razlee.com.
